title: BoJ Minutes — October 29-30, 2026 MPM (the Outlook meeting's full record)
source: EST: boj.or.jp/en/mopo/mpmsche_minu/ ('Monetary Policy Meetings'), fetched direct 2026-09-05 (HTTP 200, 41,959 bytes) and parsed cell-by-cell out of its two year tables by this session. Against the header 'Date of MPM | Outlook Report (The Bank's View) | Summary of Opinions | MPM Minutes', the 2026 October row parses exactly as ['Oct. 29 (Thurs.), 30 (Fri.)', 'Oct. 30 (Fri.)', 'Nov. 10 (Tues.)', 'Dec. 23 (Wed.)'] — i.e. the full Minutes of the October 2026 MPM publish 2026-12-23. The same page states the release time verbatim: 'MPM Minutes It will be released at 8:50 a.m.', which is 08:50 JST Wed 2026-12-23 = 18:50 EST Tue 2026-12-22. Filed estimate on two counts, identical to the nine BoJ entries already on this calendar: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy has FED: for the Federal Reserve and no slot for the Bank of Japan, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep.
notes: DISCOVERED during the boj-summary-of-opinions-2026-12-28 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05), and filed because it inverts that event's own framing rather than merely adding to it. That ledger's calendar note assumed the next BoJ text after the 2026-12-28 Summary of Opinions was the December meeting's full Minutes on 2027-01-27, five weeks later. It is not: this document publishes five days BEFORE the Summary, and it is the materially richer one. CORRECTED 2026-09-05 by this event's own initial research (docs/research/events/boj-minutes-2026-12-23.md): this note previously called these 'the complete, attributed record of a projection-round meeting — the policy debate in full, opinions tied to speakers.' The 'attributed' half is WRONG. Read this session from the exact prior-year analogue (the Oct 29-30 2025 Minutes PDF, fetched HTTP 200 / 292,911 bytes and its content streams inflated locally), the discussion convention is identical to the Summary of Opinions' — 'one member expressed the view that...', 'Some members pointed out that...', 'One of these members noted that...', 'A different member added that...', 'Meanwhile, one member said that...' — with names appearing only in the attendance roster and the vote record, and the vote is already public on decision day in the Statement on Monetary Policy. The sibling ledger boj-minutes-2027-03-24 booked the same correction for the general case from the Jan-2026 and Mar-2024 documents; this verifies it on the exact document type this entry will produce. The 'richer' half SURVIVES, on length rather than attribution: the Oct-2025 Minutes run 28 pages against the Dec-2025 Summary of Opinions' 6 (4.7x). The October 29-30 2026 MPM carried an Outlook Report (the schedule's Outlook column reads 'Oct. 30 (Fri.)'), and what an October Minutes uniquely contains — present in no other BoJ document — is the DRAFTING RECORD of the Outlook Report's own guidance paragraph, verbatim from the analogue: 'the chairman requested that the staff present possible descriptions of the future conduct of monetary policy to include in the October... Outlook Report... members shared the view that the descriptions presented by the staff were appropriate.' That is the single defensible reason to open this document, and it is read-only. SETTLED 2026-09-05: this note previously flagged that two sightings of the same Minutes-before-Summary ordering 'suggests a general property of the BoJ release schedule — the Minutes of meeting N-1 fall inside the corridor of the Summary of meeting N — rather than a coincidence at either venue, and the next pulse on either event should test it as a rule.' Tested and confirmed: all eleven Minutes year-archives AND all eleven Summary-of-Opinions year-archives were parsed this session (85 Minutes, 86 Summaries, 2016-2026) and joined on meeting, giving 84 consecutive pairs — the Minutes of N-1 precede the Summary of N 84/84 with ZERO inversions, gap median 5, mean 4.50, range 2-10, mode exactly 5 (45/84). It is a schedule law, not a coincidence. Impact is LOW: symbols is empty, no house playbook is rates- or FX-keyed, and the BoJ channel to this calendar's AI names runs through yen funding and global term premium, both second-order for a US equity book and both already owned by the FOMC ledgers. The 12-23 US session is separately crowded — PCE (confirmed, high), GDP Q3 third estimate (confirmed) and advance durable goods all print at 08:30 ET that morning, into a week with a 12-24 half day and a 12-25 closure — so nothing in that tape is attributable to Tokyo without ruling those out first. Precedent for filing a central-bank meeting-account release as its own entry: boj-minutes-2027-03-24, boj-summary-of-opinions-2027-03-29, fomc-minutes-2026-12-30 and ecb-account-2026-10-08, all kind 'macro-print'.
